retainedExactMapControl.title: Al-Masjid Al-Haram
retainedExactMapControl.description: Islam's holiest mosque in Mecca, Saudi Arabia
retainedExactMapControl.reason: Exact mapped identity supplies footprint/centerline and an undirected plan axis. Facade facing, model origin, height datum and visual fit still require review.

geometry.axisMethod: minimum-area rectangle; +X longest axis; direction ambiguous by 180 degrees

currentRoundInspection.scope: Three actually inspected pictures plus standard viewer PMTiles/DEM. Dated pictures do not verify current construction finish. No bespoke surveys or redistributed photographs.

pictures.author: Muhammad Ali Zabar
pictures.observed: Inspected enlarged inner court: dark Kaaba cloth with gold frieze and door curtain; pale curved Mataf galleries with pointed arches and a thin gold band. The two nearer gate minarets are dark/scaffold-wrapped during construction. Clock tower, cranes and crowds are excluded. Current 2026 finish is not verified.

pictures.author: Richard Mortel
pictures.observed: Inspected enlarged exterior: pale tall minarets with stepped bases, long cylindrical shafts, broad octagonal balcony/lantern stages, small upper caps and finials; paired mosque arches and pale stone bands. Green night lighting is not cladding color. Separate clock-tower complex is excluded. This dated picture guides estimated profiles, not a current as-built finish claim.

pictures.author: Wurzelgnohm
pictures.observed: Inspected enlarged older aerial linked by the retained OSM relation: open polygonal Mataf around the black/gold Kaaba, double arcade galleries, pale roofs with small tan/gold domes and paired minarets. The long Sai gallery is distinct. The northwest expansion is under construction in this older photograph; its present outline comes from current PMTiles. Temporary cranes, crowds and neighboring town are excluded.
